headline: Commercial strength offsets residential drag, guidance cut
summary_short: Revenue rose 3.0% y/y to $1.545B and operating income rose 2.1% to $356.4M, as 24% growth in Building Climate Solutions offset a 7% decline in Home Comfort Solutions; full-year EPS guidance was cut to $23.00-$24.00 from $23.50-$25.00.
summary_long: Revenue grew 3.0% y/y to $1.545B, with Building Climate Solutions up 24% (organic +15%, acquisitions +9%) offsetting a 7% decline in Home Comfort Solutions on soft residential demand. Total segment margin fell 30bp to 23.0% as mix/price gains and acquisition contributions were partly offset by lower volumes and inflation, net of $30M in tariff refunds. Diluted EPS was flat at $7.72 despite a 1.8% dip in net income to $269M, aided by share buybacks ($132M this quarter). Operating cash flow more than doubled to $172M on lower inventory. Lennox cut full-year EPS guidance to $23.00-$24.00 (from $23.50-$25.00) while reaffirming ~8% revenue growth and $750-850M free cash flow guidance.

drivers.explanation: Building Climate Solutions grew 24% (organic +15%, acquisitions +9%) on national-account strength and emergency-replacement demand; Home Comfort Solutions fell 7% on soft residential volumes, partly offset by mix-price gains and acquisitions.

Not broken out separately; the release explains the comparable total segment profit line via $39M mix/price and $17M acquisition benefit against $25M lower-volume drag and $11M inflation/absorption cost, net of $30M tariff refunds.

Total segment profit rose 2% as $39M mix/price gains and $17M from acquisitions were partly offset by $25M lower-volume drag, $11M inflation/absorption net of $30M tariff refunds, and $14M SG&A/distribution inflation.
Not disclosed by the company as a consolidated figure; tracks the 2.1% rise in operating income plus depreciation and amortization, which rose to $61.8M in H1 2026 from $52.4M in H1 2025.

Not explicitly explained by the company; per the income statement, the decline reflects higher interest expense ($14.7M vs $8.3M) and a higher tax provision ($70.6M vs $66.1M) that offset the operating-income gain.
Held flat despite the 1.8% net-income decline because diluted weighted-average shares fell to 34.8M from 35.5M, reflecting this quarter's $132M of share repurchases.

Building Climate Solutions' 24% growth and tariff-refund/pricing management offset continued residential softness. Full-year EPS guidance was cut to $23.00-$24.00 (from $23.50-$25.00) while ~8% revenue growth and $750-850M free cash flow guidance were reaffirmed.
